europe_now.title: Civil Unrest and Security Measures in France
europe_now.summary: Paris authorities have banned protests following a wave of violent demonstrations and civil unrest across the country. The ongoing social tensions have also contributed to French bond yields reaching a 24-year high.

europe_now.title: European Parliament Offices Searched in Graft Investigation
europe_now.summary: European prosecutors have conducted raids on the offices of the far-right Patriots for Europe group in Brussels and Strasbourg. The investigation centers around allegations concerning the misuse of parliamentary funds.

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Paris authorities banned public demonstrations following a wave of violent unrest across the country. The ongoing crisis has impacted the nation's financial standing, with French bond yields reaching a 24-year high.

top_stories.title: European Parliament Investigation
top_stories.summary: European prosecutors searched the offices of a far-right group located within the European Parliament. The raids were conducted in Brussels and Strasbourg as part of an inquiry into the alleged misuse of parliament funds.

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Developments in Ukraine Conflict
top_stories.summary: Russian officials announced readiness to resume three-way talks involving Ukraine and the United States. Meanwhile, fresh missile strikes were reported to have hit Kyiv amid ongoing international diplomatic efforts.

europe_now.summary: France has implemented a ban on protests following a wave of violent civil unrest that also drove French bond yields to a 24-year high. Pro-Russian social media accounts were found to have amplified public anger leading up to the demonstrations.

europe_now.summary: EU prosecutors conducted raids on the European Parliament offices of the far-right Patriots for Europe group in Brussels and Strasbourg. The searches were carried out as part of an ongoing investigation into the alleged misuse of parliamentary funds.

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Economic Impacts in France
top_stories.summary: French authorities banned protests in Paris following recent violent unrest. The widespread demonstrations have triggered economic consequences, pushing French bond yields to a 24-year high.

top_stories.title: European Parliament Investigation
top_stories.summary: European Union prosecutors executed searches at the European Parliament offices associated with a far-right group. The operation targets suspected financial mismanagement and the misuse of parliamentary funds.
